title: Hotel de Russie vs Casa Monti: Classic or Hip Boutique? (2026) | Suites With Keith
description: Hotel de Russie vs Casa Monti, compared by a travel advisor who visited both in October 2026: classic luxury or a hip boutique, neighborhoods, spas, design, dining, and who each one suits.

hero.alt: A Hotel de Russie suite living room with striped armchairs, a sofa and classical plaster roundels
A Casa Monti terrace with patterned chairs and climbing jasmine over the tiled rooftops of Monti

sub: A classic Rocco Forte with a famous courtyard, or a cute boutique hotel in a real Roman neighborhood. Both have a spa. Here is how I would choose.

choose.h3: If you want classic Rome luxury
choose.lead: I loved it. A beautiful, large courtyard, renovated rooms with lemon and orange ceilings, and a spa with an indoor pool, between Piazza del Popolo and the Spanish Steps.
choose.alt: Hotel de Russie’s large courtyard, with white umbrellas over tables and flowering balconies

choose.lead: So cute. A hip boutique hotel in Monti from the team behind Le Fantaisie in Paris, with trattorias all around and a spa couples can have to themselves.
choose.alt: A Casa Monti room with an orange banquette under a scalloped arch of bird-print fabric

band.h2: Does a classic Rome hotel sound right, or a bit too traditional?
paras: Hotel de Russie is the classic choice, and I loved it. The courtyard is where everyone gathers, and it feels like an escape from the city around it.
Casa Monti is the hotel I send people to when the de Russie or the Hassler feel too traditional. It is hip, young and fun, in a neighborhood where real Romans eat lunch.

If you are a first-timer who wants the courtyard, the pool and the walk to the Spanish Steps, pick the de Russie. If you are a younger couple who would rather live like a local in Monti, pick Casa Monti.

guide.alt: A yellow vintage Fiat 500 with the Casa Monti logo outside the hotel’s arched entrance on Via Panisperna
paras: Casa Monti is on Via Panisperna in Monti, and the neighborhood is the real thing. There are authentic Roman trattorias all around, and when I visited on a Sunday, real Romans were having lunch at them.
Hotel de Russie sits between Piazza del Popolo and the Spanish Steps, the golden triangle of Rome on foot. Step outside and you are in the crowds, so the courtyard is your escape.

guide.alt: A Casa Monti bed with a curved headboard and a wall covered in a bird and harlequin diamond print
paras: Casa Monti is from the same company as Le Fantaisie in Paris, and it shows: super cool patterns everywhere and curtains that hide the TV.
Hotel de Russie’s renovated rooms are playful too, with the cutest lemon or orange themed ceilings and marble bathrooms. I saw a stunning suite with fantastic views; ask me which one.

guide.alt: The Casa Monti spa pool, raised on golden marble steps between two white amphorae
paras: At Casa Monti, couples can book the spa just for the two of them. I arrange it before you arrive, so it is set for your stay.
Hotel de Russie has a nice spa with an indoor pool, rare in the centro storico and a real draw after a day on foot.

guide.alt: A hand-painted mural of palms, a lemon tree and a bird in a Hotel de Russie dining room
paras: At Hotel de Russie, the courtyard and its bar are the heart of the hotel, and the restaurant has hand-painted walls.
Casa Monti has a beautiful rooftop restaurant and a lively restaurant downstairs, and the trattorias outside the door are part of the reason to stay.

faq.q: Which is better, Hotel de Russie or Casa Monti?
faq.a: It depends on the kind of trip. Hotel de Russie for classic luxury, the courtyard and a spa with an indoor pool. Casa Monti if classic feels too traditional and you want something hip, young and fun.

faq.q: Which is better for a honeymoon?
faq.a: For younger honeymooners who want something fun, Casa Monti, and book the private spa. For couples who want a classic, Hotel de Russie.

faq.q: Which is better for a first trip to Rome?
faq.a: Hotel de Russie is one I recommend to Rome first-timers, between Piazza del Popolo and the Spanish Steps. Casa Monti is for living in a real Roman neighborhood.
Hotel de Russie has an indoor pool in its spa. At Casa Monti, you can book the spa just for the two of you, which makes it great for couples.

faq.q: Is there something similar to Casa Monti in a palazzo?
faq.a: Yes. For a palazzo by the Pantheon with the same real-Rome energy, look at La Minerva.
